note: Three hand-authored personas for the ReSPECT completeness grader. graderHint is set explicitly because bin/test-engines' discovery heuristic picks completenessPercent (a bare-number helper), not the composite. gradePlan returns { status, completenessPercent, satisfiedCount, mandatoryCount, firedRules } where firedRules always lists all eight mandatory rules with a 'satisfied' boolean (this is a documentation instrument: nothing is scored, rules are pass/fail). detectFlaggedIssues (flags.js) is a separate export that form-app.js composes at render time - and it depends on the wall clock for the review-date-passed flag - so flags are NOT pinned here (Phase 13 'flagsHint' tooling task); each description records the flags the persona would raise. completenessPercent counts populated field-slots, not passed rules: 14 slots always apply and a 15th (capacity assessment + non-person involvement) applies only when hasCapacity === 'no', so a plan for a person with capacity reaches 100% on 14/14. status is 'complete' only at 8/8 satisfied. No timestamp is returned by gradePlan. Regenerate 'expected' with: bin/test-personas recommended-summary-plan-for-emergency-care-and-treatment --update

personas.name: Complete plan - person with capacity, DNACPR agreed and discussed
personas.description: An 84-year-old with end-stage COPD who has capacity and has agreed a comfort-focused plan with a do-not-attempt-CPR recommendation, discussed and signed by the consultant. All eight mandatory rules satisfied; the capacity-proxy slot does not apply (hasCapacity 'yes'), so 14 of 14 slots present -> 100%. Expect status 'complete', satisfiedCount 8, mandatoryCount 8, every firedRules entry satisfied true. Unpinned flags: none (CPR documented, cprDiscussed 'yes', signed and dated, review date 2027 is in the future, health summary present).

health.healthSummary: End-stage COPD (FEV1 24% predicted) on long-term oxygen; three admissions with type 2 respiratory failure in the last year, the latest requiring NIV which he found very distressing. Frail, housebound, weight loss.
health.diagnoses: COPD GOLD D; cor pulmonale; osteoporosis; previous NSTEMI 2019
health.existingDocuments: No ADRT. LPA for health and welfare registered (daughter). Not on organ donor register.

preferences.whatMatters: To stay at home with his dog, to not be 'kept going on machines', and for his daughter to be with him.
preferences.carePreferences: Preferred place of care and death: home. Would accept antibiotics and steroids at home; does not want readmission for NIV.

recommendations.recommendedInterventions: Oral antibiotics and steroids for exacerbations at home; opioids and benzodiazepines for breathlessness and anxiety; community palliative care team involvement; oxygen for comfort.
recommendations.notRecommendedInterventions: Non-invasive ventilation; intubation and ventilation; hospital transfer unless symptoms cannot be controlled at home.

cpr.cprRationale: CPR would not be successful given end-stage lung disease and would not be in keeping with his wishes.

ceilings.treatmentCeilings: Ward-level care only if admitted for symptom control; no NIV, no critical care.

signOff.seniorEndorsement: Dr Rhian Llewellyn, Consultant in Respiratory Medicine
signOff.emergencyContacts: Community respiratory team 029 2074 7747; palliative care 24h line 029 2061 5555

state.note: Plan discussed at length with Mr Pemberton and his daughter present; both in agreement.

personas.name: Incomplete plan - lacks capacity, proxy documented, CPR recommendation not yet made
personas.description: Non-critical edge case: a 79-year-old with advanced dementia who lacks capacity. The capacity assessment and welfare-attorney involvement are properly documented, so R-CAPACITY-01 is satisfied and the conditional capacity-proxy slot both applies AND is present. Only the CPR recommendation is missing (the family meeting is booked for tomorrow). Seven of eight rules satisfied -> 'incomplete'; 14 of 15 applicable slots present -> round(93.33) = 93. Expect satisfiedCount 7 with only R-CPR-01 unsatisfied. Unpinned flags: F-CPR-NOT-DOCUMENTED-001 (high) only.

personal.address: Room 12, Braeside Care Home, Dundee DD2 1QX

health.healthSummary: Advanced Alzheimer's dementia (FAST 7c): non-verbal, fully dependent for care, recurrent aspiration pneumonia, 8 kg weight loss in 6 months.
health.existingDocuments: Welfare power of attorney registered with OPG Scotland (son). No ADRT.

preferences.whatMatters: Son reports she always said she would not want to be 'a burden' or go to hospital again; enjoys music and her son's visits.
preferences.carePreferences: Care to remain at Braeside; hospital only if comfort cannot be achieved there.

recommendations.recommendedInterventions: Comfort-focused care at the home; oral antibiotics if likely to relieve symptoms; subcutaneous anticipatory medicines available.
recommendations.notRecommendedInterventions: Intravenous therapy, artificial feeding, hospital transfer for investigation.

capacity.capacityAssessment: Assessed 2026-03-02 under the Adults with Incapacity (Scotland) Act 2000: unable to understand, retain, or communicate a decision about emergency treatment because of advanced dementia. Certificate of incapacity (s.47) in place.
capacity.proxyDetails: Pieter Achterberg, son, registered welfare attorney - consulted 2026-03-02; CPR discussion arranged for 2026-03-04.

signOff.emergencyContacts: Braeside Care Home 01382 555 010; GP out of hours 111

state.note: CPR recommendation to be completed after the best-interests discussion with the welfare attorney on 2026-03-04.

personas.name: Unsafe draft - unsigned, no CPR decision, capacity gap, lapsed review date
personas.description: Critical-highest persona: a draft started on the acute medical unit by a night nurse and never completed. Identifier blank (R-IDENTITY-01 fails), no health summary, no recommended/not-recommended interventions despite a priority balance (R-RECOMMENDATIONS-01 fails), no CPR recommendation, person recorded as lacking capacity with no assessment and involvement 'person' (R-CAPACITY-01 fails), and no signature or date (R-SIGN-OFF-01 fails). Only R-PREFERENCES-01 and R-CEILINGS-01 are satisfied -> satisfiedCount 2, 'incomplete'; 8 of 15 applicable slots present (name, DOB, preferences, priorityBalance, ceilings, hasCapacity, clinicianName, clinicianRole) -> round(53.33) = 53. Unpinned flags would be five: high F-CPR-NOT-DOCUMENTED-001, F-CAPACITY-MISSING-001, F-NO-SIGNATURE-001; medium F-REVIEW-DATE-PASSED-001 (review date 2025-01-15 is in the past on any run from 2026 onward); low F-HEALTH-SUMMARY-MISSING-001. F-DNACPR-NO-DISCUSSION-001 does not fire because no CPR decision exists to discuss.

preferences.whatMatters: Wants to see his grandson's christening next month.

state.note: Started overnight - for medical team to complete on the morning round.
